== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Mike Harrington, Star Trek CCG World Champion, makes a move during World Finals Day 2 action." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
